shared_elements: low-relief carving of animals in profile
quadruped animals with legs and tails
animal heads shown frontally or in profile row
justification: Both are low-relief carvings organized into horizontal registers containing profile animals and a repeated row of similar motifs along the top, which is about the extent of the correspondence. A is a narrative human scene — archers, a wheeled chariot, harnessed horses, human figures with weapons — while B has no humans or vehicles at all, showing instead schematic isolated animals (a feline-like quadruped, a bird, a snake-like form) and a row of arch-like animal heads, with abstract, floating placement rather than an interacting scene.
